summary.text: Dallas Kephart is a Republican state representative from Clearfield County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 73 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney, he previously worked for a judge on the Pennsylvania Commonwealth Court.

paragraphs.text: Kephart grew up in Decatur Township, Clearfield County, graduated from Philipsburg-Osceola High School, and graduated magna cum laude from Lock Haven University, according to his official biography.
As an undergraduate he interned for Congressman Glenn Thompson and spent summers working in the coal industry.
He earned a law degree from Penn State Law, where he served as a law clerk to the U.S. House Oversight Committee, and then worked for a judge on the Commonwealth Court.
Kephart's biography says he is in his second term and lists his legislative priorities as job creation, defending the Pennsylvania and United States constitutions, and constituent services.
He serves on the Energy; Environmental and Natural Resource Protection; Finance; Gaming Oversight; and Government Oversight committees.
Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate in the general election for the district.
